title: Zay's_Mobs
description: Bring your world to life with an expansive variety of unique creatures, featuring advanced ambient wildlife, hostile entities, and rare tactical drops!
body: 💖 **Enjoying the mod?** The best way to support development is by leaving a star on this page, dropping a comment with your feedback, and downloading your updates directly through Modrinth! 💬 **Join the Community:** Have suggestions, want to report a bug, or want to see sneak peeks of future updates? Click here to join our official Discord server! *** # 🦁 Zay's Mobs Bring your Minecraft worlds to life with **Zay's Mobs**! This creature expansion populates your biomes with a diverse range of unique custom entities, ranging from peaceful ambient wildlife to dangerous new hostile threats. This mod is actively developed for **NeoForge** and receives frequent content updates to expand the natural ecosystems of your world. --- ### ✨ FEATURES * **🐾 Unique Ecosystems:** Watch your biomes transform as custom creatures naturally populate the land, sky, and oceans. * **🦖 Custom AI & Behaviors:** Encounter creatures featuring completely unique movement styles, pathfinding logic, and combat patterns. * **⚔️ Rare Creature Drops:** Hunt down dangerous entities to secure unique crafting materials, trophies, and combat utility items. * **🛠️ Survival Compatibility:** All entity drops perfectly integrate into vanilla crafting logic for a seamless gameplay experience. --- ### 📷 Gallery & Images *Check out the **Gallery** tab at the very top of this page to see high-quality screenshots of the new custom mobs roaming around in their natural habitats before you install!* *Created by **ZayO3**. Found a bug or want to suggest a new wild animal or fantasy monster? Drop a comment below and let me know!*
